column9: Covers 'keep for later' (留一點) and 'stay behind' (留在家裡), and with 下 it is 留下. It builds 留學 'study abroad', 留言 'leave a message' and 留意 'pay attention'.

column3: Leave behind, and "stay behind": 留下一封信 "leave a letter". It also means to stay while others go: 你留下来.
column6: Tā liúxià le yī fēng xìn.
column7: He left behind a letter.
column9: Leave behind, and "stay behind": 留下一封信 "leave a letter". It also means to stay while others go: 你留下來.

column3: Add: 加水 "add water", 加油 "add fuel", 3 加 2 "3 plus 2".
column7: Please add a little more water.
column9: Add: 加水 "add water", 加油 "add fuel", 3 加 2 "3 plus 2".

column3: Change, become different: 天气变了 "the weather has changed". A new state follows: 变冷了 "turned cold".
column7: The weather has turned cold.
column9: Change, become different: 天氣變了 "the weather has changed". A new state follows: 變冷了 "turned cold".

column3: Turn into, become: 变 ("change") plus 成 ("become"). 变成 + noun: 变成大人 "turn into an adult".
column7: The child has become an adult.
column9: Turn into, become: 變 ("change") plus 成 ("become"). 變成 + noun: 變成大人 "turn into an adult".

column3: Become, and "succeed, complete". 他成了我的朋友 "he became my friend". 成 is in 成为, 完成, 成功 and 成绩. 成 can also mean "OK": 成！
column6: Tā chéng le wǒ de péngyou.
column7: He became my friend.
column9: Become, and "succeed, complete". 他成了我的朋友 "he became my friend". 成 is in 成為, 完成, 成功 and 成績. 成 can also mean "OK": 成！

column3: Become: 成 ("become") plus 为 ("be"). The formal word: 成为医生 "become a doctor". It is more formal than 变成.
column7: He wants to become a doctor.
column9: Become: 成 ("become") plus 為 ("be"). The formal word: 成為醫生 "become a doctor". It is more formal than 變成.

column3: To change something that exists, usually to fix or improve it: 改名字, 改错, 改日期, 改成 'change into'. Swapping one thing for another is 换. A teacher who 改作业 marks the homework. The popular picture of a stick disciplining a child is probably folk etymology.
column7: The teacher is marking homework.
column9: To change something that exists, usually to fix or improve it: 改名字, 改錯, 改日期, 改成 'change into'. Swapping one thing for another is 換. A teacher who 改作業 marks the homework. The popular picture of a stick disciplining a child is probably folk etymology.

column3: Change, alter: 改 ("change") plus 变 ("change"). 他的想法改变了 "his thinking has changed". It can take an object: 改变生活.
column7: His thinking has changed.
column9: Change, alter: 改 ("change") plus 變 ("change"). 他的想法改變了 "his thinking has changed". It can take an object: 改變生活.

column3: Do, make, handle, a loose verb for many actions: 弄坏 "break", 弄脏 "make dirty", 弄好 "get it done". It stands in for a more exact verb. Often with 把.
column6: Wǒ bǎ shǒujī nòng huài le.
column7: I broke my phone.
column9: Do, make, handle, a loose verb for many actions: 弄壞 "break", 弄髒 "make dirty", 弄好 "get it done". It stands in for a more exact verb. Often with 把.

column3: Fall, drop: 掉在地上 "fall on the floor", and as a result after a verb: 丢掉 "throw away", 忘掉 "forget".
column6: Tā de shǒujī diào zài dì shang le.
column7: His phone fell on the floor.
column9: Fall, drop: 掉在地上 "fall on the floor", and as a result after a verb: 丟掉 "throw away", 忘掉 "forget".

column3: Fall over, topple, read dǎo: 树倒了 "the tree fell". With the other reading, dào, it means "pour" (倒水) and "reverse".
column7: The tree fell over.
column9: Fall over, topple, read dǎo: 樹倒了 "the tree fell". With the other reading, dào, it means "pour" (倒水) and "reverse".

column3: Send out, issue, and "emit": 发短信 "send a text", 发烧 "have a fever". In 头发 it is another word, "hair". Read fā. 发现 is to discover and 发生 is to happen: 发生了什么事?
column6: Wǒ gěi tā fā le yī ge xìnxī.
column7: I sent him a message.
column9: Send out, issue, and "emit": 發短信 "send a text", 發燒 "have a fever". In 頭髮 it is another word, "hair". Read fā. 發現 is to discover and 發生 is to happen: 發生了什麼事?

column3: Discover, find out, notice: 发现 + clause: 我发现他不在家 "I found that he wasn't at home". It is about noticing something that was already there.
column6: Wǒ fāxiàn tā bù zài jiā.
column7: I found that he wasn't at home.
column9: Discover, find out, notice: 發現 + clause: 我發現他不在家 "I found that he wasn't at home". It is about noticing something that was already there.

column3: Something turns up in view or in a situation: 出现问题 'a problem comes up', 出现变化. The place comes first, then 出现了, then the thing: 屏幕上出现了一行字. 出 was a foot stepping out of a cave; the sprout picture came from a later misreading.
column6: Ménkǒu chūxiàn le yī ge rén.
column7: A person appeared at the door.
column9: Something turns up in view or in a situation: 出現問題 'a problem comes up', 出現變化. The place comes first, then 出現了, then the thing: 屏幕上出現了一行字. 出 was a foot stepping out of a cave; the sprout picture came from a later misreading.

column3: Raise, improve: 提高水平 "raise the level". 提 ("lift") plus 高 ("high"). It is used for things that go up: level, skill, price.
column7: I want to improve my Chinese level.
column9: Raise, improve: 提高水平 "raise the level". 提 ("lift") plus 高 ("high"). It is used for things that go up: level, skill, price.

column3: Finish, end, and as a result after a verb: 吃完 "finish eating", 写完 "finish writing". The pattern is verb + 完.
column7: I haven't finished eating.
column9: Finish, end, and as a result after a verb: 吃完 "finish eating", 寫完 "finish writing". The pattern is verb + 完.

column3: Find out and pick out: 找 ("look for") plus 出. 找出错的地方 "find where it is wrong".
column6: Tā zhǎochū le cuò de dìfang.
column7: He found where it was wrong.
column9: Find out and pick out: 找 ("look for") plus 出. 找出錯的地方 "find where it is wrong".

column3: Arrive at, come to a result, such as a conclusion: 得出结论 "reach a conclusion". 得 ("get") plus 出.
column6: Wǒmen déchū le yī ge jiélùn.
column7: We reached a conclusion.
column9: Arrive at, come to a result, such as a conclusion: 得出結論 "reach a conclusion". 得 ("get") plus 出.

column3: Accomplish, manage to do: 做 plus 到. 说到做到 "do what you say".
column6: Nǐ shuō dào jiù yào zuòdào.
column7: If you say it, you must do it.
column9: Accomplish, manage to do: 做 plus 到. 說到做到 "do what you say".

column3: See, meet with a result: 见 plus 到. 见到你 "see you, meet you". 看见 means about the same.
column7: I saw him yesterday.
column9: See, meet with a result: 見 plus 到. 見到你 "see you, meet you". 看見 means about the same.

column3: Have seen, have met: 见 plus the experience marker 过. 我见过他 "I have met him". The 过 is light.
column7: I have met him.
column9: Have seen, have met: 見 plus the experience marker 過. 我見過他 "I have met him". The 過 is light.

column3: A quick contact: bumping, or touching what you should not (别碰!). 碰到 and 碰见 mean running into someone by chance, and 碰运气 is to try your luck. To stroke or feel something, use 摸. 碰 is a late character, attested in literary works only since the Qing dynasty.
column7: Don't touch this.
column9: A quick contact: bumping, or touching what you should not (別碰!). 碰到 and 碰見 mean running into someone by chance, and 碰運氣 is to try your luck. To stroke or feel something, use 摸. 碰 is a late character, attested in literary works only since the Qing dynasty.

column3: Run into by chance, or "bump": 碰到老师 "run into the teacher".
column6: Wǒ zài lùshang pèngdào le lǎoshī.
column7: I ran into my teacher on the road.
column9: Run into by chance, or "bump": 碰到老師 "run into the teacher".

column3: Run into, with 见 ("see"), a chance meeting: 碰见朋友. It is about meeting someone unexpectedly.
column6: Wǒ pèngjiàn le yī ge péngyou.
column7: I ran into a friend.
column9: Run into, with 見 ("see"), a chance meeting: 碰見朋友. It is about meeting someone unexpectedly.

column3: Receive, be given: 受到欢迎 "be welcomed", 受到帮助 "be helped". 受 ("receive") plus 到.
column6: Tā shòudào le dàjiā de huānyíng.
column7: He was welcomed by everyone.
column9: Receive, be given: 受到歡迎 "be welcomed", 受到幫助 "be helped". 受 ("receive") plus 到.

column3: Realize, achieve a plan or a dream: 梦想实现了 "the dream came true". 实 ("real") plus 现 ("appear"): to become real.
column7: His plan came true.
column9: Realize, achieve a plan or a dream: 夢想實現了 "the dream came true". 實 ("real") plus 現 ("appear"): to become real.

column3: Take up, occupy: 占座位 "take a seat", 占时间 "take up time". It also means "account for", as in 占百分之十 "make up ten percent". Read zhàn.
column6: Tā zhàn le wǒ de zuòwèi.
column7: He took my seat.
column9: Take up, occupy: 佔座位 "take a seat", 佔時間 "take up time". It also means "account for", as in 佔百分之十 "make up ten percent". Read zhàn.

column3: Company, firm: 他在一家公司工作 "he works at a company". The measure word is 家.
column6: Tā zài yī jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.
column7: He works at a company.
column9: Company, firm: 他在一家公司工作 "he works at a company". The measure word is 家.

column3: The room where people work at desks, in a company or school (the teachers' room too). 办公 is the work itself, and builds 办公桌, 办公楼 and 办公用品. A company's branch 'office' is 分公司.
column7: The manager is waiting for you in the office.
column9: The room where people work at desks, in a company or school (the teachers' room too). 辦公 is the work itself, and builds 辦公桌, 辦公樓 and 辦公用品. A company's branch 'office' is 分公司.

column3: Work unit, organization, where one works: 你在哪个单位工作？ It is also a unit of measure: 长度单位.
column6: Nǐ zài nǎ ge dānwèi gōngzuò?
column7: Which organization do you work for?
column9: Work unit, organization, where one works: 你在哪個單位工作？ It is also a unit of measure: 長度單位.

column3: Do casual work, work part-time: 打 ("do") plus 工 ("work"), a verb and its object. It is work done for pay, often a short job. 他在饭馆打工 "he works at a restaurant".
column7: He works part-time at a restaurant.
column9: Do casual work, work part-time: 打 ("do") plus 工 ("work"), a verb and its object. It is work done for pay, often a short job. 他在飯館打工 "he works at a restaurant".

column3: Do work, labor: 干 is read gàn here, "do". The 儿 is the ending: gànhuór. It is spoken and often about physical work; 工作 is the general word for a job.
column7: Everyone is working.
column9: Do work, labor: 幹 is read gàn here, "do". The 兒 is the ending: gànhuór. It is spoken and often about physical work; 工作 is the general word for a job.

column3: Discuss, talk over: 我们商量一下 "let's talk it over". The 量 is light: shāngliang.
column7: Let's talk it over.
column9: Discuss, talk over: 我們商量一下 "let's talk it over". The 量 is light: shāngliang.

column3: Plan, noun and verb: 有计划 "have a plan", 计划去 "plan to go".
column7: What plans do you have this year?
column9: Plan, noun and verb: 有計劃 "have a plan", 計劃去 "plan to go".

column3: Handle, do, manage: 办事 "do an errand", 办护照 "apply for a passport".
column7: I'm going to apply for a passport.
column9: Handle, do, manage: 辦事 "do an errand", 辦護照 "apply for a passport".

column3: Goes before a verb (努力学习, 努力工作) and praises a person as 他很努力. It speaks of the effort, not the outcome. Teachers write 继续努力 'keep it up'.
column7: He studies very hard.
column9: Goes before a verb (努力學習, 努力工作) and praises a person as 他很努力. It speaks of the effort, not the outcome. Teachers write 繼續努力 'keep it up'.

column3: Discuss: 我们讨论了这个问题 "we discussed this problem".
column7: We discussed this problem.
column9: Discuss: 我們討論了這個問題 "we discussed this problem".

column3: Notify, notice: 通知我们 "inform us" and a noun 通知 "a notice".
column4: 老师通知我们明天考试。
column5: 老師通知我們明天考試。
column7: The teacher told us there is an exam tomorrow.
column9: Notify, notice: 通知我們 "inform us" and a noun 通知 "a notice".

column3: Demand, require, and "requirement": 要求我们 "ask us to". As a noun: 有要求 "have requirements".
column4: 老师要求我们每天练习。
column5: 老師要求我們每天練習。
column7: The teacher requires us to practice every day.
column9: Demand, require, and "requirement": 要求我們 "ask us to". As a noun: 有要求 "have requirements".

column3: Complete, finish: 完成作业 "finish homework".
column7: I have already finished my homework.
column9: Complete, finish: 完成作業 "finish homework".

column3: Carry out, conduct: 比赛正在进行 "the match is in progress". Formal. 进行 takes a noun that names an action: 进行讨论 "hold a discussion".
column7: The match is in progress.
column9: Carry out, conduct: 比賽正在進行 "the match is in progress". Formal. 進行 takes a noun that names an action: 進行討論 "hold a discussion".

column3: Use, the formal word: 使用电脑 "use a computer". 使 ("make") plus 用. It is close to 用, but suits writing and instructions.
column7: Please use this entrance.
column9: Use, the formal word: 使用電腦 "use a computer". 使 ("make") plus 用. It is close to 用, but suits writing and instructions.

column3: Choose, select: 你选哪一个？ Related: 选择.
column7: Which one do you choose?
column9: Choose, select: 你選哪一個？ Related: 選擇.

column3: Action as against words or plans: 采取行动 'take action', 付诸行动, 行动起来 'get moving'. It also means getting about physically (行动不便) and a police or military operation. 行 is xíng when it means 'to walk, to go', and háng for a row or line.
column7: We have to act at once.
column9: Action as against words or plans: 採取行動 'take action', 付諸行動, 行動起來 'get moving'. It also means getting about physically (行動不便) and a police or military operation. 行 is xíng when it means 'to walk, to go', and háng for a row or line.

column3: Behavior, conduct: 好的行为 "good behavior".
column7: His behavior is wrong.
column9: Behavior, conduct: 好的行為 "good behavior".

column3: Correct, right: 正确的答案 "the correct answer". It is formal. The opposite is 错误.
column7: This answer is correct.
column9: Correct, right: 正確的答案 "the correct answer". It is formal. The opposite is 錯誤.

column3: Accurate, precise: 时间很准确 "the time is accurate". 准 is read zhǔn. 准确 is about exactness, and 正确 about being right.
column7: Is this time accurate?
column9: Accurate, precise: 時間很準確 "the time is accurate". 準 is read zhǔn. 準確 is about exactness, and 正確 about being right.

column3: Normal: 一切正常 "everything is normal". The opposite is 不正常.
column7: Everything is normal.
column9: Normal: 一切正常 "everything is normal". The opposite is 不正常.

column3: Just right, and "happen to": 大小正好 "just the right size". As an adverb: 我正好在家 "I happened to be at home".
column7: This piece of clothing is just the right size.
column9: Just right, and "happen to": 大小正好 "just the right size". As an adverb: 我正好在家 "I happened to be at home".

column3: Is precisely: 这正是我想要的 "this is just what I wanted". 正是 + noun phrase.
column6: Zhè zhèngshì wǒ xiǎng yào de.
column7: This is exactly what I wanted.
column9: Is precisely: 這正是我想要的 "this is just what I wanted". 正是 + noun phrase.

column3: Stresses what is genuine against what only seems so: 真正的朋友, 真正理解. It is not the same as the casual 'really' of 真: you say 真好, not 真正好.
column6: Tā shì wǒ zhēnzhèng de péngyou.
column7: He is my true friend.
column9: Stresses what is genuine against what only seems so: 真正的朋友, 真正理解. It is not the same as the casual 'really' of 真: you say 真好, not 真正好.

column3: Fluent: 她的英语很流利 "her English is fluent". It describes speaking or writing.
column7: Her English is fluent.
column9: Fluent: 她的英語很流利 "her English is fluent". It describes speaking or writing.

column3: Smooth, without trouble: 一切顺利 "everything goes well". It is a common wish: 祝你工作顺利.
column7: I wish your work goes smoothly.
column9: Smooth, without trouble: 一切順利 "everything goes well". It is a common wish: 祝你工作順利.

column3: Fair, just: 公平 ("public" plus "level"). 这样不公平 "this isn't fair".
column7: This isn't fair.
column9: Fair, just: 公平 ("public" plus "level"). 這樣不公平 "this isn't fair".

column3: Equal, equality: 平等 ("level" plus "equal"). 男女平等 "equality of men and women".
column7: Men and women should be equal.
column9: Equal, equality: 平等 ("level" plus "equal"). 男女平等 "equality of men and women".

column3: Free, freedom: 我想要自由 "I want freedom". As an adjective: 很自由 "very free".
column7: I want freedom.
column9: Free, freedom: 我想要自由 "I want freedom". As an adjective: 很自由 "very free".

column3: Different: 不 plus 同 ("same"). 和…不同 "different from…". 不同的人 "different people". The opposite is 相同.
column7: Our ideas are different.
column9: Different: 不 plus 同 ("same"). 和…不同 "different from…". 不同的人 "different people". The opposite is 相同.

column3: Written, more formal than the spoken 一样: A 和 B 相同, or 相同的 before a noun. It is flat 'same', so there is no 很相同; the opposite is 不同. 相 first meant to look at, and was later borrowed for 'mutually', which is the sense in 相同.
column7: Our names are the same.
column9: Written, more formal than the spoken 一樣: A 和 B 相同, or 相同的 before a noun. It is flat 'same', so there is no 很相同; the opposite is 不同. 相 first meant to look at, and was later borrowed for 'mutually', which is the sense in 相同.

column3: Ordinary, average, and "generally": 一般来说 "generally speaking". As an adverb it goes before the verb: 我一般七点起床 "I usually get up at seven".
column7: I usually get up at seven.
column9: Ordinary, average, and "generally": 一般來說 "generally speaking". As an adverb it goes before the verb: 我一般七點起床 "I usually get up at seven".

column3: Suitable, fitting: 这双鞋很合适 "these shoes fit".
column6: Zhè shuāng xié wǒ chuān hěn héshì.
column7: These shoes fit me well.
column9: Suitable, fitting: 這雙鞋很合適 "these shoes fit".

column3: Direct, directly: 直接问他 "ask him directly". It goes before the verb. The opposite is 间接.
column7: You can ask him directly.
column9: Direct, directly: 直接問他 "ask him directly". It goes before the verb. The opposite is 間接.

column3: As you like, casual: 请随便坐 "sit wherever you like". It means any choice is fine: 随便吃 "eat whatever". As a reply to "what do you want to eat?" it means "anything is OK".
column7: Please sit wherever you like.
column9: As you like, casual: 請隨便坐 "sit wherever you like". It means any choice is fine: 隨便吃 "eat whatever". As a reply to "what do you want to eat?" it means "anything is OK".

column3: Think, consider: 我认为… "I think that…". It is more formal and firm than 觉得, and it gives an opinion after thought. 认为 + clause.
column6: Wǒ rènwéi tā shì duì de.
column7: I think he is right.
column9: Think, consider: 我認為… "I think that…". It is more formal and firm than 覺得, and it gives an opinion after thought. 認為 + clause.

column3: Think wrongly: 我以为你不来了 "I thought you weren't coming" (and you did). It points to a belief that turned out to be false. 以为 and 认为 look alike, but 以为 is used for mistaken ideas.
column6: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bù lái le.
column7: I thought you weren't coming.
column9: Think wrongly: 我以為你不來了 "I thought you weren't coming" (and you did). It points to a belief that turned out to be false. 以為 and 認為 look alike, but 以為 is used for mistaken ideas.

column3: Takes a person ('trust him') or a statement ('believe what he says'); before a clause it means 'I am confident that': 我相信你能做到. Deep trust in someone's character is 信任.
column6: Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ yīdìng néng zuò dào.
column7: I believe you can do it.
column9: Takes a person ('trust him') or a statement ('believe what he says'); before a clause it means 'I am confident that': 我相信你能做到. Deep trust in someone's character is 信任.

column3: Think of, come to mind: 想 plus 到. 我没想到 "I didn't expect it". 没想到… often starts a clause that shows surprise.
column6: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào nǐ huì lái.
column7: I didn't think you would come.
column9: Think of, come to mind: 想 plus 到. 我沒想到 "I didn't expect it". 沒想到… often starts a clause that shows surprise.

column3: Recall, remember: 想 plus 起. 想起他的名字 "remember his name". With 来 it is 想起来.
column6: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ tā de míngzi le.
column7: I remembered his name.
column9: Recall, remember: 想 plus 起. 想起他的名字 "remember his name". With 來 it is 想起來.

column3: Idea, way of thinking: 你有什么想法？ "what do you think?" It is a personal thought.
column7: What are your thoughts?
column9: Idea, way of thinking: 你有什麼想法？ "what do you think?" It is a personal thought.

column3: View, opinion: 你对这件事有什么看法？ The pattern is 对 + thing + 的看法. Close to 想法, but it is about an issue.
column4: 你对这件事有什么看法？
column5: 你對這件事有什麼看法？
column6: Nǐ duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
column7: What is your view on this matter?
column9: View, opinion: 你對這件事有什麼看法？ The pattern is 對 + thing + 的看法. Close to 想法, but it is about an issue.

column3: Point of view, opinion: 观点 plus a person: 他的观点. 同意他的观点 "agree with his view".
column6: Wǒ bù tóngyì tā de guāndiǎn.
column7: I don't agree with his view.
column9: Point of view, opinion: 觀點 plus a person: 他的觀點. 同意他的觀點 "agree with his view".

column3: Ideal, dream for the future: 我的理想是当老师 "my dream is to become a teacher". It can also be an adjective, "ideal": 很理想.
column6: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì dāng lǎoshī.
column7: My dream is to become a teacher.
column9: Ideal, dream for the future: 我的理想是當老師 "my dream is to become a teacher". It can also be an adjective, "ideal": 很理想.

column3: Understand: 懂了 "I get it". After a verb it is the result: 听懂 "understand by hearing", 看懂 "understand by reading". 听不懂 "can't understand".
column7: I don't understand.
column9: Understand: 懂了 "I get it". After a verb it is the result: 聽懂 "understand by hearing", 看懂 "understand by reading". 聽不懂 "can't understand".

column3: Understanding a principle or knowing how to act: 懂得道理, 懂得感恩, 懂得照顾自己. For grasping what you hear or read, use 懂 alone in 听懂 and 看懂.
column4: 他很小就懂得照顾弟弟。
column5: 他很小就懂得照顧弟弟。
column6: Tā hěn xiǎo jiù dǒngde zhàogù dìdi.
column7: He knew how to look after his little brother from a young age.
column9: Understanding a principle or knowing how to act: 懂得道理, 懂得感恩, 懂得照顧自己. For grasping what you hear or read, use 懂 alone in 聽懂 and 看懂.

column3: Habit, and "be used to": 习惯早起 "be used to getting up early". 我不习惯 "I am not used to it".
column4: 我还不习惯这里的天气。
column5: 我還不習慣這裡的天氣。
column6: Wǒ hái bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
column7: I'm not yet used to the weather here.
column9: Habit, and "be used to": 習慣早起 "be used to getting up early". 我不習慣 "I am not used to it".

column3: Plan, intend: 你打算去哪儿？ 打算 + verb. It is less formal than 计划. 我打算… "I plan to…".
column7: Where do you plan to go?
column9: Plan, intend: 你打算去哪兒？ 打算 + verb. It is less formal than 計劃. 我打算… "I plan to…".

column3: Count, "calculate", and "count as": 这个不算贵 "this doesn't count as expensive". 算 also means "to settle a matter": 算了 "forget it".
column7: This is not that expensive.
column9: Count, "calculate", and "count as": 這個不算貴 "this doesn't count as expensive". 算 also means "to settle a matter": 算了 "forget it".

column3: Attitude: 他的态度很好 "his attitude is good". The 度 is light: tàidu.
column7: His attitude is good.
column9: Attitude: 他的態度很好 "his attitude is good". The 度 is light: tàidu.

column3: Call, name: 称他为老师 "call him teacher". The pattern is 称 + A + 为 + B. It is also "to weigh".
column6: Dàjiā dōu chēng tā wéi lǎoshī.
column7: Everyone calls him teacher.
column9: Call, name: 稱他為老師 "call him teacher". The pattern is 稱 + A + 為 + B. It is also "to weigh".

column3: Be called, be known as: 这种鱼叫作什么？ "What is this fish called?" 叫做 is another way to write it.
column7: What is this kind of fish called?
column9: Be called, be known as: 這種魚叫作什麼？ "What is this fish called?" 叫做 is another way to write it.

column3: A lasting attitude of treating something as important: 重视教育, 重视健康. The passive is 受到重视 or 得到重视. 注意 is paying attention at this moment, not valuing. 重 shows a man carrying a bag, with 土 added later to show him standing on the ground.
column6: Wǒmen hěn zhòngshì zhè jiàn shì.
column7: We take this matter very seriously.
column9: A lasting attitude of treating something as important: 重視教育, 重視健康. The passive is 受到重視 or 得到重視. 注意 is paying attention at this moment, not valuing. 重 shows a man carrying a bag, with 土 added later to show him standing on the ground.

column3: Way, means to deal with something: 想办法 "think of a way", 没办法 "nothing can be done".
column7: Let's think of a way together.
column9: Way, means to deal with something: 想辦法 "think of a way", 沒辦法 "nothing can be done".

column3: Method: 学习方法 "study method". It names a systematic way of doing something. Compare 办法, which is a way out of a problem.
column7: This method is very good.
column9: Method: 學習方法 "study method". It names a systematic way of doing something. Compare 辦法, which is a way out of a problem.

column3: Way of doing something, practice: 他的做法不对 "his way of doing it is wrong". It judges what a person did.
column7: His way of doing it is wrong.
column9: Way of doing something, practice: 他的做法不對 "his way of doing it is wrong". It judges what a person did.

column3: Aspect, side: 在…方面 "in terms of…". 在学习方面 "in terms of study". It marks the area being talked about.
column6: Tā zài xuéxí fāngmiàn hěn nǔlì.
column7: He works hard in his studies.
column9: Aspect, side: 在…方面 "in terms of…". 在學習方面 "in terms of study". It marks the area being talked about.

column3: Reason, cause: 迟到的原因 "the reason for being late".
column7: What is the reason for being late?
column9: Reason, cause: 遲到的原因 "the reason for being late".

column3: So it was!, on finding out the truth: 原来是你 "so it's you". It also means "originally": 原来的名字 "the original name".
column7: Oh, so it's you!
column9: So it was!, on finding out the truth: 原來是你 "so it's you". It also means "originally": 原來的名字 "the original name".

column3: As a noun it is the result (考试结果). Opening a clause it means 'in the end', usually a surprise or a bad turn; for a neutral 'finally' use 最后. 果 is also 'fruit', and a plant that bears fruit is jiēguǒ.
column4: 我睡过头了，结果迟到了。
column5: 我睡過頭了，結果遲到了。
column6: Wǒ shuì guò tóu le, jiéguǒ chídào le.
column7: I overslept and ended up late.
column9: As a noun it is the result (考試結果). Opening a clause it means 'in the end', usually a surprise or a bad turn; for a neutral 'finally' use 最後. 果 is also 'fruit', and a plant that bears fruit is jiēguǒ.

column3: Purpose, aim: 你来的目的是什么？ "What is your purpose in coming?" It is the goal behind an action.
column6: Nǐ lái de mùdì shì shénme?
column7: What is the purpose of your coming?
column9: Purpose, aim: 你來的目的是什麼？ "What is your purpose in coming?" It is the goal behind an action.

column3: Reason, sense, principle: 有道理 "makes sense", 讲道理 "be reasonable". 你说得有道理 "what you say is right". The 理 is light: dàoli.
column7: What you say makes sense.
column9: Reason, sense, principle: 有道理 "makes sense", 講道理 "be reasonable". 你說得有道理 "what you say is right". The 理 is light: dàoli.

column3: Characteristic, feature: 这个城市的特点 "the features of this city".
column7: What are the features of this city?
column9: Characteristic, feature: 這個城市的特點 "the features of this city".

column3: Condition, requirement: 条件很好 "conditions are good", 有条件 "have the means". It covers both circumstances and terms.
column7: The conditions here are very good.
column9: Condition, requirement: 條件很好 "conditions are good", 有條件 "have the means". It covers both circumstances and terms.

column3: Chance, opportunity: 好机会 "a good opportunity". 有机会 "if there is a chance". 机 here is not "machine".
column6: Zhè shì yī ge hǎo jīhuì.
column7: This is a good opportunity.
column9: Chance, opportunity: 好機會 "a good opportunity". 有機會 "if there is a chance". 機 here is not "machine".

column3: Effect, function: 起作用 "take effect", 有作用 "be effective". It names what something does.
column7: This medicine works well.
column9: Effect, function: 起作用 "take effect", 有作用 "be effective". It names what something does.

column3: Key point, emphasis: Read zhòngdiǎn here. 这是重点 "this is the key point". 重点 can also be an adverb: 重点学习.
column7: Please remember this key point.
column9: Key point, emphasis: Read zhòngdiǎn here. 這是重點 "this is the key point". 重點 can also be an adverb: 重點學習.

column3: Picks out the biggest part among several: 主要原因, 主要问题, and as an adverb 主要是… 'mainly'. It does not mean 'important': you can say 这很重要 but not 这很主要.
column7: What is the main reason?
column9: Picks out the biggest part among several: 主要原因, 主要問題, and as an adverb 主要是… 'mainly'. It does not mean 'important': you can say 這很重要 but not 這很主要.

column3: Center: 城市中心 "the city center". Also in names of places: 购物中心 "shopping center".
column7: The school is in the city center.
column9: Center: 城市中心 "the city center". Also in names of places: 購物中心 "shopping center".

column3: Question, problem: 有问题吗？ "any questions?" 问题 can be a question you ask or a problem with something: 没问题 "no problem".
column7: Do you have any questions?
column9: Question, problem: 有問題嗎？ "any questions?" 問題 can be a question you ask or a problem with something: 沒問題 "no problem".

column3: Matter, affair, thing: 很多事情 "many things". The 情 is light: shìqing. It is broader than 事.
column6: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào zuò.
column7: I have many things to do.
column9: Matter, affair, thing: 很多事情 "many things". The 情 is light: shìqing. It is broader than 事.

column3: A good thing: 好 plus 事. 这是一件好事 "this is a good thing".
column7: This is a good thing.
column9: A good thing: 好 plus 事. 這是一件好事 "this is a good thing".

column3: Benefit, advantage: 对…有好处 "be good for…". 多运动对身体有好处. The opposite is 坏处. The 处 is light: hǎochu.
column6: Duō yùndòng duì shēntǐ yǒu hǎochu.
column7: Exercising more is good for your health.
column9: Benefit, advantage: 對…有好處 "be good for…". 多運動對身體有好處. The opposite is 壞處. The 處 is light: hǎochu.

column3: Harm, disadvantage: 对…有坏处 "be bad for…". The opposite is 好处. The 处 is light: huàichu.
column7: What harm is there in doing it this way?
column9: Harm, disadvantage: 對…有壞處 "be bad for…". The opposite is 好處. The 處 is light: huàichu.

column3: Used for a point of view in set patterns: 从……角度看 'seen from the angle of', 换个角度想 'think of it another way'. The same word measures an angle in geometry.
column4: 你可以换一个角度想一想。
column5: 你可以換一個角度想一想。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ huàn yī ge jiǎodù xiǎng yī xiǎng.
column7: You could look at it from another angle.
column9: Used for a point of view in set patterns: 從……角度看 'seen from the angle of', 換個角度想 'think of it another way'. The same word measures an angle in geometry.

column3: Influence, affect: 影响学习 "affect study". As a noun: 有影响 "have an influence".
column6: Tiānqì yǐngxiǎng le wǒ de xīnqíng.
column7: The weather affected my mood.
column9: Influence, affect: 影響學習 "affect study". As a noun: 有影響 "have an influence".

column3: Here 得 is read dé: "get, obtain, win". 得到 "receive", 取得 and 得出 use it. 得分 is "score a point". 得了第一名 "came first". The other 得 is the light particle in 跑得快.
column7: He came first.
column9: Here 得 is read dé: "get, obtain, win". 得到 "receive", 取得 and 得出 use it. 得分 is "score a point". 得了第一名 "came first". The other 得 is the light particle in 跑得快.

column3: A light particle linking a verb to how it goes: 说得很好 "speaks well", 跑得很快 "runs fast". The verb comes first and the description follows; do not mix it up with 的 or 地.
column7: She speaks very well.
column9: A light particle linking a verb to how it goes: 說得很好 "speaks well", 跑得很快 "runs fast". The verb comes first and the description follows; do not mix it up with 的 or 地.

column3: A light particle after a verb to say you have had an experience: 去过中国 "have been to China". The negative is 没去过. It differs from 了, which marks completion.
column7: I have been to China.
column9: A light particle after a verb to say you have had an experience: 去過中國 "have been to China". The negative is 沒去過. It differs from 了, which marks completion.

column3: Let, make, ask someone to: 妈妈让我早点睡 "Mom told me to sleep early". 让我看看 "let me see". It is followed by a person and a verb.
column7: Mom told me to go to bed early.
column9: Let, make, ask someone to: 媽媽讓我早點睡 "Mom told me to sleep early". 讓我看看 "let me see". It is followed by a person and a verb.

column3: Serve as, be: 当老师 "become a teacher". Also "when", in 当我到家时 "when I got home". Read dāng here. With the fourth tone, dàng, it means "treat as".
column4: 当我到家时，天已经黑了。
column5: 當我到家時，天已經黑了。
column6: Dāng wǒ dào jiā shí, tiān yǐjīng hēi le.
column7: When I got home, it was already dark.
column9: Serve as, be: 當老師 "become a teacher". Also "when", in 當我到家時 "when I got home". Read dāng here. With the fourth tone, dàng, it means "treat as".

column3: Opens a time clause, 'by the time' or 'once' something happens, and the main clause often has 就 or 再: 等到毕业再说 'we'll see after graduation'. It can look ahead or back. Plain 等 is only 'wait'.
column6: Děngdào nǐ lái, wǒmen jiù chīfàn.
column7: When you arrive, we'll eat.
column9: Opens a time clause, 'by the time' or 'once' something happens, and the main clause often has 就 or 再: 等到畢業再說 'we'll see after graduation'. It can look ahead or back. Plain 等 is only 'wait'.

column3: Equal to: 二加三等于五 "two plus three equals five". 等于 also means "amounts to": 这等于没说.
column7: Two plus three equals five.
column9: Equal to: 二加三等於五 "two plus three equals five". 等於 also means "amounts to": 這等於沒說.

column3: Here 倒 is read dào, a word for contrast: 这件衣服倒不贵 "this shirt, in fact, isn't expensive". It also means "pour": 倒水. With the third tone it is dǎo, "fall over".
column6: Zhè jiàn yīfu dào bù guì.
column7: This piece of clothing isn't expensive, actually.
column9: Here 倒 is read dào, a word for contrast: 這件衣服倒不貴 "this shirt, in fact, isn't expensive". It also means "pour": 倒水. With the third tone it is dǎo, "fall over".

column3: Here 只 is read zhǐ, "only": 我只有一个哥哥 "I only have one older brother". It goes before the verb. As a measure word for animals it is zhī.
column6: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yī ge gēge.
column7: I only have one older brother.
column9: Here 只 is read zhǐ, "only": 我只有一個哥哥 "I only have one older brother". It goes before the verb. As a measure word for animals it is zhī.

column3: Lean on, depend on: 靠自己 "depend on oneself". It also means "near": 靠窗 "by the window".
column6: Tā kào zìjǐ xuéhuì le Hànyǔ.
column7: He learned Chinese by himself.
column9: Lean on, depend on: 靠自己 "depend on oneself". It also means "near": 靠窗 "by the window".

column3: Through, open, and "connect": 这条路不通 "this road is blocked". 想通 means "work something out".
column7: This road doesn't go through.
column9: Through, open, and "connect": 這條路不通 "this road is blocked". 想通 means "work something out".

column3: Save: 省钱 "save money", 省时间 "save time". It is also "province", read shěng: 广东省.
column7: You can save money by taking the subway.
column9: Save: 省錢 "save money", 省時間 "save time". It is also "province", read shěng: 廣東省.

column3: Separate, part: 他们分开住 "they live apart".
column7: They live apart.
column9: Separate, part: 他們分開住 "they live apart".
